caption: The drawing depicts a bag that is rectangular at the top and tapers to a gathered point at the bottom, where it is finished with a decorative tassel consisting of multiple strands. The upper section of the bag is a golden-tan color and is bordered at both the top and where the bag tapers by a row of small green flower or leaf motifs. In the center of the golden-tan section, there is a circular floral design featuring green leaves and red-pink flowers. The lower section of the bag is blue and is ribbed, converging towards the point where the tassel is attached. To the right of the main colored drawing, there is a smaller sketch in black and white of a similar bag, displaying a scene with a building and trees in the center instead of the floral design; this sketch also includes the tassel at the bottom. The background is plain and uncolored. The name "Eugène Bartz" appears below the small sketch.
title: Bag
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
